data.explanation: This is a friendly first reminder from an online furniture retailer for an unpaid invoice of €249.00. If you have already paid, the letter says you can ignore it. If not, transfer the amount to the given account by the stated date. No late fee or further consequence is mentioned in this letter, but if it remains unpaid you may later receive a formal reminder (Mahnung) with additional costs. Keep proof of payment in case of any dispute.
